subject: Human Evolution
title: Darwin's Prediction
description: A fast breakdown of Darwin's Prediction for builders.

hook.text: Charles Darwin never found a human fossil, yet he predicted exactly where to look for our origins.

buildup.text: In 1871, he wrote that humans likely originated in Africa, where our closest relatives—apes—still live.

discovery.text: At the time, most scientists bet on Asia. Darwin's Africa hypothesis was a minority opinion.

twist.text: Fifty years later, Raymond Dart's Taung Child proved Darwin right. Africa was the cradle after all.

climax.text: Darwin used logic where others used bias. His prediction is one of science's great vindications.

punchline.text: He never dug a fossil but pointed the shovel.

quiz.question: Where did Darwin predict humans originated?
